rationale: Probability taken from the assumption table of handbook WE-053 (illustrative figures), A-2: the Office enforces the requirement against controllers with an establishment in Corvany.
Probability taken from the assumption table of handbook WE-053 (illustrative figures), A-1: the requirement binds; many covered controllers would host abroad without it.
Probability taken from the assumption table of handbook WE-053 (illustrative figures), A-12: enforcement against foreign services without an establishment is weak.

No matching assumption in WE-053; judged from the text: fines reach only controllers with an establishment or assets in Corvany, and the Office has never issued a blocking order, so a controller that keeps hosting abroad faces little real risk of punishment.
No matching assumption in WE-053; judged from the text: a foreign provider may comply by operating servers in Corvany, so providers are not left with nothing to sell.

No matching assumption in WE-053; judged from the text: about 950 controllers already host in Corvany, in their own data centers or with local colocation firms, so local hosting is an acceptable substitute for many.
Probability taken from the assumption table of handbook WE-053 (illustrative figures), A-13: local operators, providers and controllers near the line can organize at a cost below their stake.

Probability taken from the assumption table of handbook WE-053 (illustrative figures), A-8: for some controllers near 50,000, deleting inactive records or splitting between controllers costs less than compliance.
No matching assumption in WE-053; judged from the text: hosting is a service bought as it is used and cannot be stored or ordered ahead of the effective date.

No matching assumption in WE-053; judged from the text: the annual audit of physical security and access logs and the fee of 40,000 crowns per facility go beyond what some of the nine facilities may already meet; the text does not say how many.

Probability taken from the assumption table of handbook WE-053 (illustrative figures), A-2: the Office enforces the requirement against firms with an establishment in Corvany; the facilities are in Corvany.
No matching assumption in WE-053; judged from the text: a fee of 40,000 crowns per facility is small against facility revenue of 30 to 120 million crowns a year, so most obtain the certificate.
No matching assumption in WE-053; judged from the text: facilities are fixed sites in Corvany that host covered data, so unlicensed hosting is easy to see.
Probability taken from the assumption table of handbook WE-053 (illustrative figures), A-26: some controllers hosting in Corvany colocation move to a provider's local region when it opens.

No matching assumption in WE-053; judged from the text: the audit covers physical security and access logs, which controllers may value but may also check themselves; the text gives no evidence either way.
Probability taken from the assumption table of handbook WE-053 (illustrative figures), A-13: local operators and providers can organize at a cost below their stake.
Probability taken from the assumption table of handbook WE-053 (illustrative figures), A-22: the supplementary appropriation is paid from the general budget, with no named tax.
